visualLanguage: design_system/public/PUBLIC_UI.md (locked 2026-08-11). The index.html in this directory is the RETIRED KB-era mockup and is kept only because ci:mockup-coverage requires a parity.json beside any index.html. It is not the visual target for this route any more. The target is the six closed patterns in PUBLIC_UI.md, built from components/site/v3.
competitiveTarget: Beat generic national-brokerage profile pages by leading with verified facts, a concrete origin, live city inventory, and direct-broker doors. Zero marketing-speak except the locked D11 mission sentence.
note: Migrated off the KB register onto the v3 barrel 2026-08-13 (E-ABOUT). Rhythm: three of the six patterns (Quiet, Instrument, Ledger), no two adjacent alike, chrome exempt. Order is Breadcrumb, Quiet (mission + origin, headingLevel 1), Instrument (founded / firm license / principal broker), Ledger (service-area cities from market_pulse_live), Quiet (FAQ and edges), Footer. PUBLIC_UI.md opens About on Quiet + Sheet. The family's Sheet lives on /contact and /team/[slug], where the capture forms already were. A new on-page form here would be a new capture contract. The ask on this page is the valuation door with ?from=/about. D11: the mission sentence is the one virtue-word exception, exact words, We. City rows skip a missing median rather than printing zero under a live-MLS source line. Dates render in Pacific through formatDate. KB-era deletions this migration made: KbHero (including property search), KbAbout, KbExploreTowns, KbTestimonials, KbArticles, KbSell, KbTeam (already removed from this page 2026-07-08), FAQBlock, SmoothScrollProvider, KbFooter, kb-root, kb.css import.

requiredComponents.name: MetadataBlock
requiredComponents.section: AboutPage + aboutOrganization + BreadcrumbList + FAQPage JSON-LD. V3Quiet and V3Instrument carry no structured data of their own.

requiredComponents.name: KbNav
requiredComponents.section: The public header, mounted by app/layout.tsx through PublicNav / V3Chrome. Not a page-level import; ci:mockup-parity auto-satisfies this entry while the layout owns the header.

requiredComponents.name: KbSectionTracker
requiredComponents.section: Page-level analytics, pageType='about'. Kept on the KB register deliberately: section tracking is analytics wiring, not visual language, and the barrel ships no equivalent.

requiredComponents.name: V3Breadcrumb
requiredComponents.section: Chrome. Home > About. Surface tone (this page opens on Quiet, not a dark Stage). Current page never a link.

requiredComponents.name: V3Quiet
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 6, twice. Opening: the locked D11 mission sentence, origin facts (Matt, fire service, Red Erickson, June 2023), doors to /team /reviews /contact. Closing: the same FAQ array the FAQPage JSON-LD uses, plus outbound edges and any city that had no publishable median.

requiredComponents.name: V3Instrument
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 1, once. Founded date, firm license OREA 201253677, principal broker license linking /team/matthew-ryan. Source line names Oregon Real Estate Agency. Ask is Value my home via valuationHref('/about'), variant primary, because at 390 the chrome valuation CTA sits inside the collapsed menu.

requiredComponents.name: V3Ledger
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 3, once. One figure row per service-area city that returned a live market_pulse_live row carrying a median list price. Value column is formatPrice of that median. Trace names live MLS through Oregon Data Share, single-family, city rows from market_pulse_live. Stamp is formatDate of the newest updated_at. Empty branch uses emptyMessage.

requiredComponents.name: V3Footer
requiredComponents.section: Chrome. V3_FOOTER_COLUMNS. Rendered OUTSIDE <main> so the footer maps to role=contentinfo.

layoutComponents.name: PublicNav
layoutComponents.note: Resolves to V3Chrome today. The KbNav entry above is the one the gate auto-satisfies.

deferredComponents.name: V3Sheet
deferredComponents.reason: About destinations open on Quiet + Sheet, but the capture forms already live on /contact and /team/[slug]. Adding a Sheet here would be a new capture contract.

deferredComponents.name: V3Stage
deferredComponents.reason: Pattern 4 needs owned media and is never allowed over a number. Opening on Stage would also require tone=on-media on the breadcrumb over a Quiet first viewport.

deferredComponents.name: V3Field
deferredComponents.reason: Pattern 2 is live inventory as a spatial surface. It opens Homes. Using it here would compete with /homes-for-sale.
